lede: Monday night, Telluride Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and the property tax levy that funds it — and in the same session takes up second reading of an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's 5% cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year, a real trade-off worth showing up for. The school board opens its meeting with a debrief on November ballot results, including the 5A mill levy override, which will determine what the district can actually do next year. The gondola re-opens for winter on Friday, and the Backcountry Film Fest runs Wednesday and Thursday if you need a reason to get out of the house mid-week.

notable.stake: Council votes on 2027 budget, tax levy, and Open Space Fund suspension.
Board debriefs November ballot results, including school mill levy override 5A.
Fire district considers financing options and votes on second-reading budget.
HARC hears long-awaited Shandoka Lot large-scale redevelopment preliminary reviews.
County repeals austerity measures and adopts formal AI governance policy.
THA subcommittee rules on unconventional loan and occupancy exceptions for lottery units.
Norwood considers Land Use Code change altering Planning and Zoning Commission structure.
